name: Đầu ghi hình Hikvision DS-7104HQHI-K1(S) Turbo HD DVR
summary: H.265+/H.265/H.264+/H.264 encoding for the main stream, and H.265/H.264 for the sub-stream of analog cameras
Up to 3 MP resolution for recording of channel 1 of DS-7104HQHI-K1, channel 1/2 of DS-7108HQHI-K1, and channel 1/2/3/4 of DS-7116HQHI-K1
Supports real-time 1080p lite and when enabled, the image effect is similar with 1080p
Up to 2-ch 4 MP IP cameras input
Long distance transmission over UTP and coaxial cable: max. 800m for 1080p and 1200m for 720p HDTVI signal
description_html:
DS-7104HQHI-K1(S)

H.265+/H.265/H.264+/H.264 encoding for the main stream, and H.265/H.264 for the sub-stream of analog cameras

Self-adaptive HDTVI/HDCVI/AHD/CVBS signal input

Up to 3 MP resolution for recording of channel 1 of DS-7104HQHI-K1, channel 1/2 of DS-7108HQHI-K1, and channel 1/2/3/4 of DS-7116HQHI-K1

Supports real-time 1080p lite and when enabled, the image effect is similar with 1080p

Up to 2-ch 4 MP IP cameras input

Long distance transmission over UTP and coaxial cable: max. 800m for 1080p and 1200m for 720p HDTVI signal

4/8/16-ch synchronous playback
